description: Builds the Google searches for what a Shopify store sells from its catalogue (each kind of product with its attributes and audiences), keeps those a model judges are for its products, and checks the largest it has no collection for on Google today. Returns the missing pages worth building, with monthly searches and who ranks, and collections Google doesn’t show for searches they cover. Uses DataForSEO Google data and the store’s public catalogue. Free, no sign-in; waits up to 45 seconds of a run’s usual 1–4 minutes. Shared per store for 7 days. Anything it could not judge is reported as unknown, never as a finding.

country.description: The market to check, as a two-letter ISO country code such as GB. Omit it for the store’s main market.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: find_missing_pages
title: Missing pages finder
